definitions.explanation: A person who travels into unknown or dangerous regions to investigate them, such as polar, jungle, or deep-sea explorers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{探検家|たんけんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I listen to a famous explorer's story.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、{探検家|たんけんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I wanted to become an explorer.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{探検家|たんけんか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{入|い}れたこと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}した→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: That explorer set out for a land no one had ever set foot in.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{探検|たんけん}→探検：17461_tanken⟧ (exploration) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (a person who does ~, as a profession or pursuit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {探検家|たんけんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become an explorer
- ⟦{冒険家|ぼうけんか}→冒険家：20564_boukenka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{探検家|たんけんか}: adventurers and explorers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冒険家|ぼうけんか}→冒険家：20564_boukenka⟧: adventurer — emphasizes thrill and risk over investigation
- ⟦{探検隊|たんけんたい}→探検隊：25022_tankentai⟧: an expedition team
